name: ClausePlaybookLibrary
tagline: Your contract playbook as an app – preferred, fallback and walk-away positions with the right approvals.
description: A complete clause playbook for Power Apps and Power Pages: clause standards with preferred, fallback and walk-away positions, approval levels and negotiation guidance, a position checker that logs deviations against deals, an approval matrix, lifecycle with four-eyes approval and a review schedule.
features: Preferred / Fallback 1 / Fallback 2 / Walk-away ladder with approval levels
Position checker and deviation logging (PositionTier, RequiredApproval)
Lifecycle with four-eyes approval, publish review date, reasons for return/retire
Bulk actions, CSV export and undo
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
